tdx.allowed_tcb_statuses admits SWHardeningNeeded beside UpToDate (owner decision 2026-10-07, coordination/owner_decisions_2026_10_07_direction_defaults.md item 1); OutOfDate, Revoked and ConfigurationNeeded stay refused.

tdx.allowed_os_images carries one entry per Phala instance size, because RTMR0 measures the VM configuration (cpu_count, memory_size): dstack-0.5.9 is tdx.small (1 vCPU, 2 GiB); dstack-0.5.9-tdx.large is tdx.large (4 vCPU, 8 GiB; owner 2026-10-12 item 4). Same OS image, so MRTD/RTMR1/RTMR2 are equal. The large tuple was computed with dstack-mr diagnose (Dstack-TEE/dstack 4699c48e) over the published dstack-0.5.9 image and a live tdx.large CVM's vm_config, then matched a live DCAP-verified quote (docs/evidence/phala_tdx_2026_10_12_large/).

dstack-0.5.12 (os_image_hash 8db40cb23008d6213668b5816702d100b37b859a8a5bfd18d938ae3a1b3715bd) is admitted beside dstack-0.5.9 because Phala disabled dstack-0.5.9 (bd369a8c) for new CVMs on 2026-10-14 (ERR-02-013); running 0.5.9 CVMs keep their entries until they are rolled. Computed with the same recipe as the 0.5.9 pins: dstack-mr diagnose (Dstack-TEE/dstack 4699c48e) over the published meta-dstack v0.5.12 image (tarball sha256 e3037d99..., digest.txt = os_image_hash), with the 0.5.9 vm_config changed only in os_image_hash and image; the same tool reproduces the 0.5.9 pins. The tdx.large tuple equals the live Phala-reported (tcb_info; independent DCAP appraisal pending first-boot sign-off) tcb_info of an operator-run CVM (tdx.large, dstack-0.5.12, the admitted split compose); the tdx.small tuple is computed only, not yet matched against a live tdx.small quote. RTMR0 is unchanged from 0.5.9 per size; MRTD/RTMR1/RTMR2 changed (docs/evidence/phala_tdx_2026_10_14_dstack0512/).

dstack-0.6.1 (os_image_hash ec43cb8c5e04b6bb6c53b33b16076a01d83d01f7f4b703f2f78a0d947d6247e6) is admitted beside dstack-0.5.9 and dstack-0.5.12 (owner option A, coordination/owner_decisions_2026_10_11_protected_option_a_dstack060.md: its guest Docker Engine is 26.1.5, which meets the API v1.45 floor). Computed with dstack-mr diagnose built at Dstack-TEE/dstack v0.6.1 (7f143148) and, as a cross-check, at 4699c48e (both agree; the v0.6.1 build reproduces the 0.5.9 and 0.5.12 tdx.large pins), over the published mkosi-os-v0.6.1 dstack-0.6.1.tar.gz (sha256 7583f51c..., sha256(sha256sum.txt) = os_image_hash), with the guest-agent vm_config of the live test CVM test-dstack061-2130 (tdx.large, 2026-10-14) for tdx.large and that vm_config with only cpu_count 1 / memory_size 2 GiB for tdx.small. The tdx.large tuple equals that CVM's Phala-reported tcb_info (all four registers; independent DCAP appraisal pending first-boot sign-off); the tdx.small tuple is computed only. MRTD equals the staged dstack-0.6.0 MRTD (same firmware); RTMR0 is unchanged from 0.5.x per size; RTMR1/RTMR2 changed (docs/evidence/phala_tdx_2026_10_14_dstack061/).
